[Uniqueness near cusps] 1. 9.5.6\group thurston.ch09.interpolationSource: thurston:page-0264Source: thurston:page-0265 An uncrumpled surface realizing an essentially complete lamination in a fixed homotopy class is unique and is totally geodesic near its cusps.
